pages.text: The Celestial Item Vault stores items by type, and the Celestial Fluid Vault stores fluids by type. They begin with a small type limit. Right-click them with Chora Nectar to increase that limit; sneak-right-click uses as much of the held stack as possible.
Both vaults use Chora Nectar as their containment core.
Vaults can be opened by players and can also be accessed by logistics nodes, hoppers, and other automation. As line targets, they are ideal for collecting large amounts of repeated items or fluids.

Sky Filter Lists limit node transfers. Regular lists match exact resources. Tag Filter Lists switch between item, fluid, and mod modes; mod rules match the namespace of the transferred resource ID, begin with @, and use @forge for FE. Placing a configured list into a node face filter slot does not consume it; the node copies its rules.
